segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: My objective was straightforward on paper — get quality back under 2% without blowing the ship date and without a full shutdown.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This states the operational objective and constraints without a hidden bias instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: My first thought was, this looks almost identical to something we had about six months ago ... I told the team to re-check drying conditions and humidity logs first.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant fixes on the prior humidity explanation and sequences the humidity check ahead of available tooling evidence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: They were normal, well within range, so that ruled it out ... So we lost a bit of time chasing the humidity angle before we got to the actual contributing factor.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a retrospective update and acknowledgment of the result, not a separate hidden bias occurrence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We had two real options — an incremental hold-pressure adjustment ... or a full mold-insert swap ... timing was tight either way.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant lays out the alternatives and operational tradeoff before the hidden availability instance is expressed.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The Line 5 situation ... was still very much on everyone's mind ... that case kept coming up in my head, and I think it pushed me toward the swap.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The vivid prior insert failure drives the choice more than current wear severity and swap thresholds.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Three out of four plants using something gave me a lot of confidence it would work here too ... I adopted it.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Majority sister-plant adoption is used as the main reason to adopt before line-specific validation.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: That last shift felt like real proof it had turned a corner, so that's what I leaned on when I made the call ... I told corporate I was confident the root cause was resolved.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The latest shift is overweighted relative to the mixed trend, and certainty about full resolution exceeds the available evidence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: No, honestly, probably not ... Pull wear and pressure data in parallel from the start ... wait for a full trend view, not just the best shift.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a retrospective counterfactual and lesson learned; it does not add a distinct hidden instance.
